enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Place the head on the pillow. Adjust the arm under the pillow. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the left side. Move the legs. Stretch the arms. Turn onto the back again. Pull the blanket to the chin. Remain motionless. Roll to the right side. Place the hand on the mattress. Remain still until the alarm sounds.

Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap handle. Let the water run. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Rub the soap over the face. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn the tap handle off. Turn the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the refrigerator. Pull the refrigerator door open. Take out the milk carton. Take out the eggs. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Take out a plate. Close the cupboard door. Place the bowl on the counter. Pick up the bread. Place the bread on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Crack the eggs into the bowl. Stir the eggs with a fork. Place the bowl in the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave start button. Wait. Open the microwave door. Take out the bowl. Place the bowl on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a cup. Pick up the cup. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Stand up. Pick up the plate and bowl. Walk to the sink. Place the plate and bowl in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the wardrobe. Pull the wardrobe door open. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Take out socks. Close the wardrobe door. Place the clothes on the bed. Take off the pajama top. Take off the pajama bottoms. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the trousers. Fasten the belt. Sit on the bed. Put on the socks. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the phone. Press the phone screen on. Check the phone screen. Place the phone in the pocket. Pick up the bag. Walk to the bedroom door. Pull the door open. Walk out. Pull the door closed.

Walk out of the house door. Pull the house door closed. Lock the door with the key. Walk along the path to the street. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Press the phone screen on. Look at the phone screen. Place the phone back in the pocket. The bus arrives. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the pocket. Tap the card on the reader. Walk along the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail. Stand holding the handrail. The bus stops. Release the handrail. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Reach the workplace entrance. Push the entrance door open. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the uniform. Put on the uniform. Close the locker. Walk to the nurse station. Sit down at the desk. Pick up the pen. Write notes on the chart. Put down the pen. Pick up the phone. Dial the internal number. Speak into the phone. Place the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the patient room. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the monitor display. Remove the cuff. Place the cuff on the cart. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Remove the thermometer. Read the display. Write the readings on the chart. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit down. Pick up the pen. Fill in the medication record. Stand up. Walk to the medication cabinet. Open the cabinet. Take out the medication box. Close the cabinet. Walk to the patient room. Hand the medication and cup to the patient. Wait for the patient to swallow. Take the cup back. Walk to the nurse station. Sit down. Pick up the phone. Answer the call. Speak into the phone. Place the phone down. Pick up the pen. Write on the chart.

Walk out of the workplace entrance. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Press the phone screen on. Look at the phone screen. Place the phone back in the pocket. The bus arrives. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the pocket. Tap the card on the reader. Walk along the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail. Stand holding the handrail. The bus stops. Release the handrail. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the path to the house. Take the key out of the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the house door open. Step inside. Pull the door closed.

Walk into the kitchen. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the refrigerator. Pull the refrigerator door open. Take out the vegetables. Take out the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap handle. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn the tap handle off. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put down the knife. Pick up the frying pan. Place the frying pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker button on. Pour oil into the frying pan. Pick up the vegetables. Place the vegetables into the frying pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Pick up the meat. Place the meat into the frying pan. Stir the food with the spatula. Press the induction cooker button off. Pick up a plate. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button on the remote control. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote control on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone. Press the phone screen on. Scroll the phone screen. Place the phone on the sofa. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Wait for the computer to start. Move the mouse. Click the mouse button. Type on the keyboard. Look at the monitor. Move the mouse. Click the mouse button. Type on the keyboard. Stand up. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote control on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone. Press the phone screen on. Scroll the phone screen. Speak into the phone. Place the phone on the sofa. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Pick up a cup. Fill the cup with water at the sink. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the cup. Drink the water. Place the cup on the table. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button off. Place the remote control on the sofa. Stand up. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap handle. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Rub the soap over the face. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn the tap handle off. Turn the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket back. Sit on the bed. Take off the socks. Stand up. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Put on the pajama top. Put on the pajama bottoms. Place the clothes on the chair. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the arm under the pillow. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Close eyes. Remain motionless.
